rules: 文档存储模型是首版SQLite实现策略；record字段由这些schema冻结，不能注入SQL。
RepoDocument.value必须满足其collection对应schema，不能只满足anyOf中的任意一种。
仓储可以使用固定documents(collection,key,value_json)与meta；(collection,key)唯一，受控参数绑定。
Core在BEGIN IMMEDIATE事务中检查expected_snapshot_revision和checks，成功时new_snapshot_revision=expected+1；所有mutations和meta同提交，失败全部回滚。
users以user.id为key，username_index以规范化username为key；cards以user_id为key，card_uid_index以uid_hex为key，绑定与唯一性索引同事务更新。
slot_guards以字符串1为key，申请必须检查ABSENT并PUT，结束必须核验operation_id后DELETE；REVIEW_REQUIRED保持此记录。
loans以loan.id为key；归还关闭原记录，禁止覆盖借用者。事件键固定为device_id/epoch/20位补零boot/20位补零seq，按字节序即可保持数值顺序，不经浮点。
公开API不能调用任意仓储mutation；只有Core线程构造已验证RepositoryChange。会话/密码哈希/UID行只在内部使用。
查询按collection和key参数绑定，分页按key字节序；key与after_key互斥，页大小同时受limit和65535字节上限，未读完必须返回next_after_key。
恢复接口按collection分页，不一次装载无限历史；Core在开放请求前按同一snapshot_revision完成必要集合恢复。
locker_repo_import_events在同一事务做新事件去重导入、合法projection_change及连续游标推进；重复输入不能重复改变投影。
u64以经校验的十进制文本存储，禁止SQLite浮点/lexicographic大小比较；比较长度后比较同长度文本或在C以uint64解析。
日志格式化/数据库损坏不自动清库，schema不兼容明确报错；初始化只走本机CLI。

Vision captures/pinned policy/evidence belong to Core transactions; public query projections are sanitized; images and paths never enter RepositoryChange. Model/camera/policy changes only apply between operations; restart invalidates in-flight captures and requires reconciliation.

vision_evidence key is canonical operation_id + / + evidence_id (73 bytes). Core starts list at operation_id+/, returns only that prefix and matching operation_id fields, stops at first other prefix. Exact evidence references construct the same key. Cursor is opaque and bound to operation_id/snapshot_revision; never scan all evidence or expose another operation.

internal_rpc.encoding: UTF-8 JSON without BOM or trailing NUL
rules: One packet contains exactly one JSON object, no batches. Duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, trailing data and unknown fields are rejected.
Service socket rejects supervisor methods; supervisor socket rejects business and presence methods. subscribeChanges is unavailable over RPC.
SO_PEERCRED and socket filesystem permissions create trusted peer identity; principal and source are never accepted from JSON.
Public methods reuse the public operationId route, path/query types, params body schema, authentication, idempotency, success status and success/error schema.
LVGL uses asynchronous IPC. Replies match request_id; Core submission_token remains private and cannot be supplied by an RPC client.
Nested public body.request_id equals envelope request_id. Preserve public status; 204 has body=null.
presence.submit requires owner session and trusted UI peer. Supervisor methods use bound peer instance and session_token=null.
Supervisor restart deduplicates by incident_id across request_id retries. Progress ACK proves receipt, not overall health.
Pagination honors whole-packet UTF-8 response byte limit as well as item limit; keep next cursor, never truncate JSON or a record.
An unpaged query exceeding the response cap returns bounded 503 QUEUE_FULL Error; undelivered mutation replies never cancel or re-execute committed actions.
recvmsg checks MSG_TRUNC. Oversized/truncated packets never execute; close if request_id cannot be trusted.
Never log session_token, password or sensitive raw params. Retry side effects with original idempotency_key/incident_id; never auto replay presence after reconnect.

maintenance.reconcile is local admin CLI only: no active operation, current ledger matches stable closed-door state, fresh versions and healthy journal; records reason, never pulses or erases evidence.

source_fields.principal: Core重新验证当前session_id与user/role，不相信客户端actor或之前已过期的鉴权缓存。
source_fields.request_id: 对外排障ID可来自X-Request-ID，不作为内部等待键。
source_fields.submission_token: Core每次入队由安全随机源生成，只在同进程receipt和wait_result使用；禁止客户端指定。
